scope: Reviewed OMAI formula endpoints and exact Lean proof source for local theorems with no Physlib physics counterpart. Hash and compiled-name checks detect drift and provenance errors; they are not automatic symbolic translation or numerical validation.
interpretations: fit_arrhenius is the Arrhenius law D(T) = D_0 exp(-E_a/(T k_B)) with E_a an energy per particle in joules; the catalog's fit is a weighted regression of log D against 1/T, which returns E_a exactly on Arrhenius data for any positive weights and at least two distinct temperatures.

compute_ionic_conductivity is the Nernst-Einstein relation with the tracer diffusivity (Haven ratio 1); with an Arrhenius diffusivity and a temperature-independent carrier density, sigma T is Arrhenius with E_a and sigma alone has the apparent activation energy E_a - k_B T.
